title: In This Town, You Can See How Many Days You Have Left
description: Everyone has thousands of days left. I have three. Then I found out what my number really means…

scenes.narration: In this town, everyone can see how many days they have left. It floats right above your head.
Most people have *thousands*. My neighbor, Mister Kim, has *thirty thousand*. He brags about it every single morning.
Me? I have *three*. Three days. My best friend Max stared at my number and didn't say a word for an hour.
After that, the whole town treated me like a ghost. People crossed the street when I walked by.
So I tried everything to change it. First, I ate nothing but vegetables. The number didn't move.
Then I stayed in bed, wrapped in every blanket we had. Still nothing. And then it dropped to *two*.
Then I asked the oldest woman in town. She looked at my number and whispered: it's not counting down your *life*.
On my last day, the ground started shaking.
A *giant* walked out of the mountains. Fifty meters tall. Heading straight for the school.
Everyone ran. Everyone except me. When you only have one day left, you're not scared of much.
I stood in the middle of the street. And for some reason, it *stopped*. Right in front of me.
It looked at the number above my head. Then it bent down, and it *bowed*.
And my number changed. Not to a day. To a word.
It was never counting down my life. It was counting down until the town *needed* me.
Now Mister Kim stares at his thirty thousand days, wondering what *he* is waiting for. So tell me: what would your number say?
